questions.q: Evaluate the indefinite integral of x^3/(x^4+3x^2+2) with respect to x.
questions.explanation: Put t=x^2, so x^3 dx becomes (1/2)t dt and the denominator becomes (t+1)(t+2). The fraction t/((t+1)(t+2)) splits as -1/(t+1)+2/(t+2). Integrating and returning to x gives log(x^2+2)-(1/2)log(x^2+1)+C.

questions.q: If integral [(3e^x-5e^-x)/(4e^x+5e^-x)] dx = a x + b log|4e^x+5e^-x| + C, what are a and b?
questions.explanation: Differentiate the proposed antiderivative to get a+b(4e^x-5e^-x)/(4e^x+5e^-x). Matching numerators gives 3=4a+4b and -5=5a-5b. Solving these two linear equations yields a=-1/8 and b=7/8.

questions.q: Evaluate I=integral from 2 to 8 of sqrt(10-x)/(sqrt(x)+sqrt(10-x)) dx.
questions.explanation: Let f(x)=sqrt(10-x)/(sqrt(x)+sqrt(10-x)). Under x->10-x, f(10-x)=sqrt(x)/(sqrt(10-x)+sqrt(x)), so f(x)+f(10-x)=1. The interval [2,8] is symmetric under this substitution, hence 2I=integral from 2 to 8 of 1 dx=6 and I=3.

questions.q: Which antiderivative is obtained by applying integration by parts to integral x^2 tan^-1(x) dx?
questions.explanation: Take u=tan^-1 x and dv=x^2 dx, so v=x^3/3 and du=dx/(1+x^2). This gives I=(x^3/3)tan^-1x-(1/3)integral x^3/(1+x^2) dx. Since x^3/(1+x^2)=x-x/(1+x^2), the remaining integral produces -x^2/6+(1/6)log(1+x^2), giving the stated result.
